text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking around town on my day off,
when...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Ooh, this one's nice and light!
Hm... How
about we get this?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well... I dunno. Maybe we should stick
to
something more... current.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ack! Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hello! We're thinking of getting a
present for
Maruzensky. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Well, you see, Maruzensky's talk show, Gnarly☆Gossip Time ♪ will be starting in a bit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's a really popular program, and today
is
actually her 134th time hosting it! By
the way,
this is her fourth time at this
venue...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
She invited us to come and watch, and
Chiyono O
suggested we should get
some kinda present to
thank her!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I figured with Curren by my side, we'd
be able to
find a great gift for sure! She
knows all the trends
on Umastagram!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thank you. ♪ But to me, a good
present
should—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oooh?! Is that Chiyo and Curren I see?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait, if Chiyono O is here, that must
mean... Are
you two going to Maruzen's
event?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We are! Are you guys going as well,
Spe?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We wanted to get a gift for
Maruzen
before we headed over,
though.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we're doing the same! This shop
seems to
match her style well!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! But if we all buy things here, won't
we just end
up giving her similar
presents?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Then how about we get her what we want to give her instead of what we think she'll like?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What I want to give her... What I want to
give
her...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I know! How about some
croquettes?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's just what you wanna eat!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But now that I think about it... I would love to give Maruzen a taste of the delicious food from my hometown!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait for me, Tickezo! Off to the
Hokkaido Fair
we gooo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Th-that was fast! I guess they both had
something
in mind!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You do too, don't you? Let's choose
what we
wanna give her. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: What?! But this is so difficult!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We're talking about Maruzen here. I
can't imagine
her liking something I
choose...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Is she the kind of person who'd complain
about a
heartfelt present?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sh-she would never!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She's nice to everyone—even me!
Obviously, she
would treasure the
thought behind the gift far
more than
the item itsel—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh! I know what I want to give her!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aha, so you did have an idea!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I do! There's something I received long
ago that
made me very happy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I decided against it at the time, 'cause I
thought it
would be too presumptuous a
gift, but... I think
I'll give it to her after
all!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh! Is this... a cherry blossom key chain?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes! I thought the traditional design
with that
decorative cord looked really
cute...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And, um... Actually, I have the same
one...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Really?! We're twins, then!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry for giving you a matching key
chain out of
nowhere! Feel free to throw
it away if you think
it's weird!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'd never throw it away. I'm so
grateful for
the thought you put into
this, Chiyo! Thanks. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...I don't think she's realized it herself,
but
Chiyono O's a pretty passionate
person, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sakura Chiyono O manages to
summon
the courage to give a present to
her idol.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Gasp! You're right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She talked about what she's been up to
in a
recent interview! There might be a
hint about
what she wants in my notes!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You really crammed a lot of info
into that!
Are those all notes on
Maruzen?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I take notes about everything I
think is
important.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wow... The words are so tightly packed
in there, I
wouldn't be surprised if you
copied down
everything she's ever said.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I can see why you would think that... Oh, here it is! Here are my notes on the latest issue of Umazing Trends Monthly !

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hm... "Tired," "vacation in Atami,"
"wearing
down," "modern massage
chairs"...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Umm... Is that some kind of code?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I got it! I know what to get her!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ooh, a set of bath bombs! Thank you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I've been really stiff lately, so I've been
wanting
to find a way to relax! I'm so
happy to receive
these! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe... ♪ I'm just happy you're happy.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Nothing soothes my tired soul
more than
your lovely smile, though,
Chiyo. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: O-oh! I, um... Gosh!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're always paying such close
attention to me,
dear. Thank you so
much.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe... You're welcome!
